Needs changes before merge.

The lane plan limits each group to four commands. App, kernel, UI, build, and clippy steps run alone. The tests check lane overlap, failed-build stopping, and checkout movement. The lockfile tests reject changed names and checksums.

Local results:
- The trial merge with upstream/main at 085a471 was clean. Main is already an ancestor of this head.
- `cargo test -p xtask --no-run`: passed.
- `cargo test -p xtask`: 136 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored.
- `cargo clippy -p xtask --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main --dry-run`: selected the xtask unit tests, which passed above.
- No GitHub runner was used.

Requested before merge:
1. `docs/decisions/1703-parallel-gate.md:18`: Complete the release benchmark required by issue #1703. Run the full serial and parallel release gates on the same machine and code revision. Record the commands, machine, cache state, elapsed times, and results. The four short test runs and summed lane times do not measure the full release gate. The PR states that this comparison was not done.

Notes:
- This change does not change posted G-code, geometry, collision checks, gouge checks, or stock simulation. No goldens moved. Safety-tier mutation checks do not apply. I did not change code or run mutations.
- No UI source changed. Screenshots are not required.
- The current checkout's AGENTS.md assigns the process-version bump to the merging session. The body has the required `Process change: yes` line.
- No scripts, workflows, build scripts, or dependencies changed. A maintainer-only build restriction does not apply.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Fixed the latest review's missing full release benchmark in docs/decisions/1703-parallel-gate.md.

Both full runs used reviewed revision 31dc65818dbb341c6ba199979a07e87891f84a21 on the same machine. Each attempted all 169 commands. Serial took 3982.32 seconds. Parallel took 3851.03 seconds. The record includes the commands, serial harness, machine, cache state, manifest comparison and results.

Both full runs had the same three failed commands: unchanged UI dead-code clippy errors, UI snapshot mismatches and GPU documentation snapshot mismatches. These are recorded, not presented as green release gates. No unrelated code or snapshots changed.

Validation: cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main passed all 136 xtask tests. cargo clippy -p xtask --all-targets -- -D warnings passed. git diff --check passed. This finding concerns measured evidence only; no behavior changed, so no regression pin or mutation check applies.

New head: 7d5dec275fa657c27bb5c7377d3c4c51c5e7453b.

Please re-review.

Ready for the maintainer to merge.

The new record meets the benchmark request from the last review. I checked the saved local evidence. Both runs used revision 31dc65818dbb341c6ba199979a07e87891f84a21. Each run attempted the same 169 commands. The command lists and their SHA-256 value agree with the record. Serial time was 3982.32 seconds. Parallel time was 3851.03 seconds, a reduction of 3.30%. Both runs had the same three failed commands. The record states these failures and does not claim a passing release gate.

Local results:
- The trial merge with upstream/main at 03dc12c6 was clean.
- `cargo test -p xtask --no-run`: passed.
- `cargo test -p xtask`: 136 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored.
- `cargo clippy -p xtask --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- `git diff --check`: passed.
- The quick-gate dry run completed. Its merge-base scan includes changes from main in the trial merge. I ran the xtask tests that cover this PR. I did not run those unrelated suites.
- All build and test commands ran locally. No GitHub runner was used.

Requested before merge: none. The previous benchmark request is complete.

Notes:
- The PR changes gate tools and the lockfile check. It does not change posted G-code, geometry, collision checks, gouge checks, or stock simulation. No goldens moved. Safety-tier mutation checks do not apply. I did not change code or run mutations.
- No UI source changed. Screenshots are not required.
- No scripts, workflows, build scripts, or dependencies changed.
- The merged tree's current process rule assigns the version bump to the merging session. The body has `Process change: yes`.
- The body still says the full benchmark was not run. Update that text to match the new record. This text does not block merge.
- The saved full release runs had UI clippy and snapshot failures. I checked that evidence; I did not repeat the full release runs in this review.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
